## `bin/` -- Scripts and Tools

### Authentication / Credentials

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `bin/assume_role` | AWS role assumption: calls `aws sts assume-role`, writes `~/.aws/credentials`, prints caller identity. |
| `bin/aws_account` | Prints current AWS account ID via `aws sts get-caller-identity`. |
| `bin/fast-aws-creds` | Caches `ada credentials print` output to `/tmp/aws_credentials_<hash>` for 900 s. Cleans up expired cache files. Falls back to fresh fetch on miss or expiry. Used as `credential_process` in `~/.aws/config`. |
| `bin/fast-kube-creds` | Caches `aws eks get-token` output to `/tmp/k8s_token_<hash>` for 600 s. On first call, injects itself as a `kubectl` exec credential plugin for the current context. |
| `bin/login.sh` | Idempotent Midway auth gate. `--check` (from `.zshrc`): validates cookie and SSH cert; if invalid and TTY, prompts mwinit automatically; non-TTY: warns only. No args: force-refresh via `mwinit`, sync cookie and SSH cert to dev desktop over `scp`. |

### Setup

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `bin/install-home.sh` | Bootstrap: `git init ~`, add remote (`https://github.com/ellistarn/home.git`), fetch, `reset --hard origin/main`. |
| `bin/setup/setup.sh` | Orchestrates machine setup. Runs all `*.sh` scripts in `~/bin/setup/` (except itself) in sorted order. Idempotent. |
| `bin/setup/services.sh` | Syncs service configs from `~/.services` to system locations. Linux: systemd units + Caddy config. macOS: launchd plists (user agents). Marks managed files, prunes orphans, reloads/restarts changed services. Idempotent. |

## Agent Skills (`~/.agents/skills/`)

Skills are loaded by agents using the skill tool. Each is a `SKILL.md` file.

| Skill | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `debug` | Root-cause a known bug through evidence, not speculation. Load when a test is failing, flaking, or producing wrong results. |
| `declaring-designs` | Properties of a well-formed design. Load when creating or iterating on a design. |
| `finish` | Completion checklist. Load before declaring any task complete. |
| `reconcile-agents-md` | Regenerate `.AGENTS.md` from scratch. Full process: `git ls-files` -> read sources -> write with header -> spot-check. Never patch; always full replacement. |
| `reconcile-instrumentation` | Reconcile code instrumentation against the system's decision points. Load when adding or reviewing diagnostic logging. |
| `reconcile-organization` | Reconcile code structure against its architecture by drawing boundaries at the right levels -- packages, files, structs, functions. |
| `reconcile-quality` | Reconcile implementation quality against designs -- correctness, performance, observability, testing, simplicity. |
| `using-krocodile` | Krocodile resource authoring reference. Load when writing or reviewing krocodile YAML. |
